verdict.rationale: BILL's Spend & Expense marketing says every card transaction is 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant' through AI-powered spend management, and the plan offers automatic 2-way sync with ERPs such as NetSuite and Sage Intacct, which supports coding at transaction time. That is a single marketing claim with no detail on how merchant, category, or memo coding works. The attachment and AI coding evidence covers AP bills rather than card spend, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented receipt capture/matching for card transactions, memo and merchant field coding at swipe time, depth on how categorization maps to GL codes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
